results.title: Kathmandu to face Chitwan in NPL Eliminator after loss to Pokhara
results.content: Kathmandu finish third with a 55-run defeat, while Kushal Bhurtel misses a century by one run as Pokhara post a record 224.

results.title: Nepal sets up accreditation centre to ease testing and certification
results.content: The agency aims to reduce testing costs, strengthen quality assurance and help Nepali products gain international recognition, but exporters say it could take up to three years to secure global accreditation.

results.title: Bhurtel falls one run short as Pokhara post record NPL total
results.content: Kushal Bhurtel hits 99 off 51 balls as Pokhara Avengers pile up 224 for three against Kathmandu Gorkhas, the highest total in the competition’s history.

results.title: Changing farming practices threaten food and habitats of migratory birds
results.content: The expansion of winter crops, shrinking wetlands, and rising use of pesticide are putting the survival of thousands of birds arriving in Nepal from Tibet, Mongolia, and Siberia at risk.

results.title: Bhattarai urges Prime Minister Shah to put five issues on agenda for India visit
results.content: In an interview with Kantipur, the former prime minister says Nepal should press India on the border dispute, trade deficit, air routes and hydropower, while seeking trilateral cooperation on the Himalayan climate crisis.

results.title: India’s Nitin Gadkari to attend Nepal Infrastructure Summit as keynote speaker
results.content: The December 9–10 summit will bring together policymakers, investors and development partners to discuss infrastructure financing, regional connectivity and climate-resilient projects.

results.title: Nākaloka makes Kathmandu debut with an evening of music, devotion and silence
results.content: The movement brought together spiritual traditions, music and meditative practices in an evening of collective reflection at Basantapur.

results.title: And then there were four: Lumbini lead NPL playoff pack
results.content: The defending champions sealed the top spot with a four-wicket win over Biratnagar, leaving Sudurpaschim, Kathmandu and Chitwan to fight over second to fourth on Sunday.

results.title: Lamichhane asks China-bound MPs to keep third countries out of talks
results.content: The RSP chair asks the 20-member delegation to focus on Nepal-China ties and study China’s experience in governance, technology and development.

results.title: Is Nepali politics forgetting its own history?
results.content: From BP Koirala’s social democracy to the Maoists’ revolution, parties have experimented with big ideas in a short time. Few seem to look back at how those experiments went.

results.title: Nepal’s psychedelic mushrooms need experts, not hype
results.content: Psilocybin holds medical promise, and Nepal could become a safe destination for it. That depends on putting qualified experts in charge, with government support, before an unregulated trade takes hold.

results.title: AI is coming to Nepal either way. The real question is who’s in charge
results.content: Adopt or resist is the wrong debate. What matters is whether Nepal keeps the power to choose, govern and adapt the technology it buys.

results.title: Deuba faction prepares parallel provincial conventions ahead of Kathmandu gathering
results.content: The dissident faction of Congress plans to complete the provincial conventions by December 4 before holding a parallel national convention in Kathmandu from December 7 to 9.

results.title: International recognition is no proof of serving global capital
results.content: The record of Nepal’s finance and climate policymakers complicates claims that they are simply advancing Western economic interests.

results.title: Tinkar residents bear the cost of Kathmandu’s border rhetoric
results.content: Residents of Chhangru and Tinkar depend on India for travel, supplies and trade. Disputes over Lipulekh and Kalapani make that dependence increasingly difficult.
